source: paraphrase of the 'therapy' and 'self-harm' FAQ entries in routes/pages.py (build_faqs)
snippet: You can take the PHQ-9 and GAD-7 screening questionnaires from the assessment page whenever you want a check on how you have been feeling. They are screening tools, not a diagnosis. If an answer there is about thoughts of self-harm, the app shows helpline numbers right away.
